args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate following its deploy. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified**: all regions are now running v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** for checkout-api documenting the failure and the rollback — the on-call engineer has been paged.
